source.file: hsuanice_Session Fix - Split Items at Fade Edges.lua

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - New: Session Fix - Interchange Prep, one window that checks and fixes a session before Interchanger (Pro Tools / Nuendo / Cubase). - Removed: the five separate scripts (Edges Off Grid, Looped Source Items, Misaligned Crossfades, Overlap Items, Split Items at Fade Edges) - their checks are part of the new window. Re-assign shortcuts / toolbar buttons to the new script. - Requires ReaImGui and the hsuanice Library package.

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Change: each check shows a short coloured title and a one-line description; colour = impact on the sound in an editing session (red print / delete, orange big change, yellow small change, green sound unchanged, grey review only), with a legend above the list.

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Add: Mixed channels can be fixed - one track per channel count as played ("<track> mono / stereo / 4ch ..."); the group with the most items stays on the original track, fewer channels above, more below; folders stay intact. Runs after Channel mode. - Change: Off grid follows the project grid setting and shows the grid unit; edges 1 sample off the grid are snapped (inward to the next grid line). - Change: off-grid edges zoom to one grid step either side; Save report asks where to save; no fold arrow in the title bar. - Change: in the lists only the first column stretches; Track / Position / Take keep their width when a column is resized.

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Fix: list columns were squeezed and jumped back when resized; columns now keep their width and the list scrolls sideways when it is wider than the window. - Add: lists can be sorted - click a column header (up / down / original order); Shift+click selects a range in the order shown. - Fix: Fix on Fade shapes missed fades on hidden tracks / inside collapsed folders (only Fix All reached them); they are fixed now. - Change: Folders comes right after Hidden tracks; the title bar and its close button use the chosen font size. - Fix: a broken crossfade (fades not matching the overlap) could not get its shape and was set to an invalid value; it is now marked "fix Crossfades first" and left alone until Crossfades has fixed it. - Add: issues that need another check first (hidden tracks / collapsed folders, broken crossfades) show it in colour in front; fixing such a check alone asks to fix that first (Yes = first that, then this check).

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - Add: Workflow cues (last check) - removes the #in / #out / #Glue cues that glue / render leave in WAV files, only for files inside the session folder, in place (same file, audio untouched); other cues, take markers and project markers stay. Asks first (cannot be undone with Undo). - Add: Scan shows a progress bar with Cancel instead of freezing REAPER, and the time of each check (the slowest are shown). - Add: Tiny items check - editing slivers under 2 frames for review; 2-pops (xx:59:58:00 or after the last audio) are recognized and left out. - Add: Tiny items - mark tail pops as 2-pop from the list, or write "2-pop" / "tail pop" in the Item Notes, so they are left out.
